title: Critical Thinking: baseline vs canonical skill
description: Paired skill evaluation. Canonical skill source revision: fc530b6815eead24aa8655cbbb4bfe0dd8c9f666. Baseline A versus skill-loaded B. Outputs require independent blinded scoring; Q-Batch verifies instrumentation only.
system_prompt: Complete the task directly. Be accurate, follow the user's stated constraints, and distinguish facts from uncertainty. Do not claim to have used tools or inspected sources that are not provided.

tasks.prompt: A video shows a thin, curved tree apparently holding a large boulder. One explanation says the tree grew around it. But the stem looks juvenile, the crown needs light, and the boulder may be supported by lower rocks. Investigate plausible natural growth, deliberate construction, staging and synthetic-media explanations. Reconstruct the causal timeline needed for each. Do not assume the clip is real or fake.

How do trap-jaw ants generate extremely fast jaw strikes? Explore the mechanism, whether similar mechanisms evolved more than once, possible uses beyond prey capture, and what engineering has actually transferred. Separate established findings from predictions and unknowns.

A flower becomes translucent when wet. I suspect the effect may come from its structure rather than being an adaptation whose primary purpose is transparency. Investigate both possibilities, the physical mechanism, what comparisons with related species could reveal, and what evidence would distinguish them.
